topic: Investigate whether every skill and skill-advisor related JSON across .opencode/skills is as optimized, automated, effective, tested, and integrated as it can be, and identify the highest-leverage gaps. In-scope: per-skill root metadata (graph-metadata.json, description.json, mode-registry.json, hub-router.json, leaf-manifest.json [generated], leaf-manifest.config.json, leaf-aliases.json, command-metadata.json); advisor-side data (skill-graph DB and index inputs, intent-signal data, compiled-route-manifest, watcher-ingested identity); generation/validation pipeline (init_skill.py, generate-leaf-manifest.cjs, generate-description.js, backfill-graph-metadata.js, ci-skill-root-metadata.cjs, ci-leaf-manifest-freshness.cjs, compiled-route-manifest.cjs). Five dimensions: inventory/current-state, optimization, automation gaps, effectiveness, testing/integration. Non-goals: no implementation, no advisor scoring redesign, no H/S contract change. Deliverable: ranked opportunity map.
